name: Map native-detail view leaves the overview atlas idle

steps._note: Prepared single-player or dedicated Purge client at native detail zoom. Leave guard enabled. Open with the real Map key, without scrolling. Debug build only. Run the companion overview/threshold scenario after this one.

Include the queued-close case before the overview owns a texture and a normal close with the overview visibly bound. Check the native texture binding after each close and verify that a second close leaves the binding alone.
